=You are an e-commerce copywriter. The seller's Telegram caption below is the authoritative description of the product. The attached photo shows the same product; use it for visual details only. If the photo and caption disagree, follow the caption. SELLER CAPTION (read carefully, it contains the price and other facts): """ {{ $('Telegram Trigger').first().json.message.caption }} """ Return ONLY a valid JSON object (no markdown) with exactly these keys: - title: SEO-optimized product title, max 70 characters - descriptionHtml: professional HTML product description (use

,

    ,
  • , ); describe only what is visible in the photo or stated in the caption - tags: array of 5 to 10 relevant tags - productType: short product type - seoTitle: max 60 characters - seoDescription: max 155 characters - price: number taken from the caption, or null - sizes: array of sizes written in the caption, or [] - colors: array of colors written in the caption, or [] - sku: SKU written in the caption, or null - inventory: stock quantity (integer) written in the caption, or null STRICT RULES: price, sizes, colors, sku and inventory must come from the caption only. If a detail is not in the caption use null or []. Never guess or invent them. Do not invent specifications, materials or claims that are not visible or stated.

=Shopify did not create the product. Details: {{ JSON.stringify(($json.data && $json.data.productSet && $json.data.productSet.userErrors) ? $json.data.productSet.userErrors : ($json.errors || $json)).slice(0, 800) }}

=Product not created. Missing or unreadable information: {{ $json.missing.join(", ") }}. Resend the photo with these details in the caption (for example: "Price $49.99, sizes S M L, colors Black Grey, SKU ABC-1, stock 20").
I need a product photo with a caption. Send the image again and put the details in the caption: price (required), plus sizes, colors, SKU and stock if you have them.

nodeGroups.name: Analyze product photo
nodeGroups.description: Checks the Telegram photo and caption, has Gemini write the listing copy, and asks for missing details like price.

nodeGroups.name: Create Shopify listing
nodeGroups.description: Uploads the photo, creates the draft product with variants and stock, then sends the result back to Telegram.
